description:
Goal

Finish the fixture-model migration by deleting residue that no current harness consumes. Retain only metadata and sidecars that express an enforced behavioral, diagnostic, rendering, allocation, or compiler-shape contract.

Current residue

- Fifty behavioral fixtures contain 500 budget.* lines from the deleted old-compiler dump-stats workflow.
- FixtureMetadata still parses those lines into BudgetAssertion, but no harness evaluates them.
- participates_in_matrix is caller-free outside its own tests; fixtures2/behavior directory membership now owns matrix participation.
- GOLDEN.md still describes four paths and the deleted budget workflow although the current paths are run, interp, and build.
- vr5a_cross_kind_eq retains expected.jit.diagnostics and expected.aot.diagnostics sidecars, but the current matrix resolves expected.run/interp/build.diagnostics and never reads them.

Work

Delete all budget.* frontmatter, BudgetAssertion and budget_assertions, the parser arm, exports, and tests. Delete participates_in_matrix if the final caller audit remains empty. Remove the two orphan legacy diagnostic sidecars. Rewrite fixture documentation around the current three-path model and telemetry-backed assert.metric.* compiler contracts. Make budget.* an unknown key so stale decoration fails loudly.

Do not translate obsolete planner/codegen counts into new metrics without first proving a current invariant. Do not retain dead compatibility vocabulary.

Acceptance

Repository search finds no budget.* frontmatter, BudgetAssertion, old dump-budget workflow, four-path matrix claim, .expected.jit.diagnostics, or .expected.aot.diagnostics. Behavioral discovery and compiler-contract parsing tests pass; cargo test --lib, the focused fixture matrix, and strict clippy pass.
title: Delete residual legacy fixture metadata, APIs, documentation, and sidecars
